messages:
nina (partnerships): quick sync 1: SI partner wants a 'Datadog + Redwood' launch checklist for our co-marketing. needs to include observability integration steps and privacy callouts.
omar (eng-ml): add step: confirm model telemetry doesn't leak prompt text; prefer aggregate token counts and model id only.
lisa (obs PM): include recommended thresholds for canary: p95 < 200ms, error-rate < 0.5% for hosted. will vary for dedicated.
infra-bot: infra deploy: preview dashboard upload complete - https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/dd-redwood-checklist (token expires in 48h)
nina (partnerships): i'll assemble checklist and run by legal. want it in the marketplace tile assets as a PDF and in the onboarding repo.
omar (eng-ml): also include a tracing span example with model call attributes: `span.name: redwood.inference`, `attributes: {"model":"gpt-3.5x", "tokens_in": 42, "tokens_out": 128}`
lisa (obs PM): good. add troubleshooting steps: check collector endpoint, verify DD-API-KEY permissions, and sample sampling config to reduce volume.
nina (partnerships): great. target: have assets ready by Monday. will post final checklist here.
